units.source_text: 行近宇治山庄，忽闻弹琴之声，不知所奏何曲，只觉十分凄凉。

en.t: As he approached the Uji mountain villa, he suddenly heard the sound of strings being played; he could not tell what piece it was, only that it felt deeply mournful.

units.source_text: 薰君想道：“我闻八亲王常常演奏音乐，过去没有机会，不曾领教他那有名的琴声。

en.t: Kaoru thought, "I have heard that Prince Hachi often plays music, but until now I have never had the chance to hear his famous playing.

units.source_text: 今天躬逢其盛了。”

en.t: Today I have come upon it myself at last."

units.source_text: 便走进山庄，仔细一听，这是琵琶之声，曲调是黄钟。

en.t: He went into the villa and listened carefully; it was the sound of a biwa, tuned in the oshiki mode.

units.source_text: 虽然只是世间常弹的乐曲，恐是环境所使然，似有异乎寻常之感，其反拨之声清脆悦耳。

en.t: Although it was only a piece commonly played in the world, perhaps because of the setting it seemed unusually moving, and the returning strokes of the plectrum rang clear and pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 其间又有哀怨而优雅的筝声，断断续续地响出。

en.t: Among it there also sounded, now and then, the plaintive yet elegant notes of a koto.

units.source_text: 薰君意欲暂时听赏，正思躲藏，身上的香气早就引人注意。

en.t: Kaoru wanted to listen for a while and was just thinking of hiding himself, but the fragrance on his body had already drawn attention.

units.source_text: 便有一个形似值宿人员的鲁男子走出来，对薰君说：“为了如此如此，亲王闭居山寺，容小人前往通报。”

en.t: Then a rough-looking man, apparently one of the night attendants, came out and said to Kaoru, "For such-and-such reasons, His Highness has secluded himself in the mountain temple. Allow me to go and announce you."

units.source_text: 薰君道：“何必去通报呢！

en.t: Kaoru said, "Why trouble yourself to announce me?

units.source_text: 功德限定日期，不可前往打扰。

en.t: The religious observance has its fixed period, and I must not go and disturb him.

units.source_text: 但我如此冒霜犯露而来，空归未免扫兴。

en.t: But after coming all this way through frost and dew, it would be rather disappointing to return with nothing.

units.source_text: 相烦告知小姐，但得小姐为我说声‘可怜’，于愿足矣。”

en.t: Please tell the young ladies for me; if only they would say a word of pity for me, I would be quite satisfied."

units.source_text: 这鲁男子的丑陋的脸上露出笑容，答道：“小人便去叫侍女传告。”说过就走。

en.t: A smile spread over the rough man's ugly face, and he answered, "I will go call a waiting woman to pass on the message," and with that he left.

units.source_text: 薰君唤他回来：“且慢！”

en.t: Kaoru called him back: "Wait a moment!"

units.source_text: 对他说道：“多年以来，我只是听人传说你家小姐弹得好琴，今天机会真巧啊！

en.t: He said to him, "For many years I have only heard people say that the young ladies of your house play beautifully. What a fortunate chance today is!

units.source_text: 可否找个地方，让我暂时躲着听赏一下？

en.t: Could you find some place where I might hide for a little while and listen?

units.source_text: 突然进去打扰她们，害得她们都停止弹奏，是不应该的。”

en.t: It would not be right to burst in and disturb them, making them stop playing."

units.source_text: 薰君容貌丰采之美丽，即使是这不解情趣的鲁男子，看了也深为感动，肃然起敬。

en.t: Kaoru's face and bearing were so beautiful that even this coarse man, who understood nothing of refinement, was deeply moved and looked on him with solemn respect.

units.source_text: 他答道：“我家小姐当无人听见之时，常常弹琴奏乐。

en.t: He replied, "When no one is there to hear them, the young ladies of our house often play the koto and other music.

units.source_text: 但倘京中有人来到，即使是仆役，她们就肃静无声了。

en.t: But if someone comes from the capital, even a servant, they fall silent at once and make no sound.

units.source_text: 大约是为了亲王不要一般世人知道我家有这两位小姐，所以隐藏起来。

en.t: I suppose His Highness wants to keep people in general from knowing that these two young ladies are here, and so he keeps them hidden away.

units.source_text: 他曾经说过这话呢。”

en.t: He once said as much himself."

units.source_text: 薰君笑道：“哪里隐藏得了呢！

en.t: Kaoru laughed and said, "How could they possibly be hidden?

units.source_text: 他虽然如此严守秘密，但世人都已知道你家有两个绝色美人了。”

en.t: Though he guards the secret so strictly, everyone already knows that your house has two incomparable beauties."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“你带我去吧！

en.t: Then he added, "Take me there.

units.source_text: 我不是好色之人。

en.t: I am not a lustful man.

units.source_text: 只因知道你家有如此秘藏的两位小姐，觉得很奇怪，颇想知道她们是否也和世间寻常女子一样而已。”

en.t: I only find it strange that your house has two young ladies kept so carefully hidden, and I merely want to know whether they are like ordinary women in the world."

units.source_text: 那人说：“却是苦也！

en.t: The man said, "This is a real difficulty!

units.source_text: 我做了这不识轻重的事，日后被亲王得知，定要挨骂了。”

en.t: If His Highness later learns that I did such a reckless thing, I will certainly be scolded."

units.source_text: 两女公子居处，前面围着竹篱，间隔殊严。

en.t: The dwelling of the two young ladies was enclosed in front by a bamboo fence, with the barriers kept very strict.

units.source_text: 这值宿人便引导薰君前往。

en.t: The night attendant then guided Kaoru there.

units.source_text: 薰君的随从人被邀到西边廊上，也由这人招待。

en.t: Kaoru's attendants were invited to the western gallery, where this man also entertained them.
